rules.text: // no bulk action there is no control that decides more than one thing
// no default reason the box starts empty and nothing ever writes into it
// no undo a decision is final; the card says so before the stamp, not after
// no pre-fill switching cards never carries a reason across
// no retry a write that may have landed is never sent twice
inbox: "the one write path in this product — a typed reason, no bulk action, no default, no undo",

optional: sha (computed by the emitter; verified when supplied)

headComment.text: // ask.mjs -- every decision the Council chamber and Ask arc make.
// The two rooms share a module because they share the thing that makes them the same room in
// two moods: BOTH ARE READS. The Council chamber renders a verdict a panel of agents earned;
// Ask arc renders an answer a brain assembled. Neither may act, and the audit that proves it
// (noHandsAudit) is one function used by both.

can.text: "ask-arc": "a brain with no hands — it reads the live state, cites the ULID, and cannot stamp anything",
/ What Ask arc is granted. Nothing here can write; ask costs a governed receipt and says so. */
halfLine: No model, no key, no spend. Every number below was computed from the log by L2 — ${source}. This half cannot hallucinate a receipt because it never w…

cannot.text: * REQ-07's rule is "zero write tools", and a room can honour that in two ways:
// Ask arc renders an answer a brain assembled. Neither may act, and the audit that proves it
// ULID via L2 marks the answer *unverified* (never silently kept)" is a DoD line, not a
* unverified at least one claim did not resolve, OR the brain marked itself unverified.

vocabulary.text: * write this door writes the spine itself. There is exactly one.
* receipt a GOVERNED subprocess writes under policy, budgeted and tier-pinned.
* none reads only; nothing about the route can reach the spine's writer.

title.text: ADR 1307 — FACE-H: Ask arc runs as a governed engine process, zero write tools

oneLiner.text: A brain that answers from live state is useful; a brain with hands is unconstitutional.
